summary: Frontend-only regression of the 7HUES homepage redesign at REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL (https://road-unfolds.preview.emergentagent.com). Verified hero cleanup, single continuous cream canvas, new section order/titles/indices (01..07), removal of standalone Our People section, Experience editorial themes, WHY 7HUES 4 items, road SVG + scroll-motorcycle repositioning, no console/page errors, no broken images, mobile 390x844 has zero horizontal overflow with mobile-menu working, and the Book Your Ride form still POSTs /api/bookings 200 -> booking-success. All 12 requested acceptance checks pass on both desktop (1440x900) and mobile (390x844).
critical_code_review_comments: Hero <video> boolean attributes render as autoplay='' / loop='' / muted absent in DOM; playback works because React sets them as properties, but for consistency + SSR-safety consider using JSX booleans (autoPlay loop muted playsInline) or checking that muted is actually applied — autoplay requires muted in Chrome/Safari.

section-experiences computed backgroundColor is rgba(0,0,0,0) (transparent) and inherits the cream from the parent wrapper — matches spec, but it also means any future accidental wrapper change will silently darken the section; adding an explicit bg-sand class on the section itself would harden this against regressions.

Motorcycle inline style updates on every scroll frame (measured left/top/transform mutating). Rotation swings from -1° to +26° to -24° across a short scroll range which reads as jitter; user acknowledged rotation polish is deferred, but consider clamping/lerping the tangent-angle derivative to avoid the twitch.

Some section indices (01..07) are visually rendered inside the section text — good for a11y, but they are also used in verification. Prefer keeping the numeric label separate (e.g. an <span data-testid='section-index'>) to decouple copy edits from tests.
seed_data_creation: One TEST_ prefixed booking POSTed via /api/bookings during the regression check (returned 200, booking-success shown). No admin/user data created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Homepage acceptance checks are codified inline in this iteration (see the two playwright scripts in the run log). Key selectors: [data-testid=hero], hero-eyebrow, hero-book-cta (play-showreel MUST be absent), sections in order section-about, section-what-we-do, section-how-we-deliver, section-why, section-experiences, section-from-the-road, section-journal, section-people MUST be absent, why-item-0..3 (why-item-4 absent), scroll-motorcycle style must mutate on scroll. Booking regression: /book -> booking-form -> fill field-* -> booking-submit -> booking-success + POST /api/bookings 200.
rca of the issue: N/A — this iteration was a redesign verification, not a bug hunt. All acceptance criteria in the review request were met.
